summary: The mail check gives a complete answer, and you no longer see rights you do not need.

fixes.title: Mail check reads both sending identities
fixes.text: The mail check now checks both sending identities instead of showing a line as not checked. If it cannot read them, the Mail sender step no longer stays open.

fixes.title: User Access Administrator shown only when needed
fixes.text: It is no longer mentioned when no Azure resource delegation is defined.
